name: satisfaction
description: A momentary sense of mild positivity or relief that your situation is progressing on the path that you had hoped for.
perceptions: A perceived outcome is progress towards a larger desire.
results: If the outcome is perceived to affect your world, the experience would be delight or happiness.
examples: Inspecting the results of a job didn't reveal any problems.
The vacuum is still dead as expected after trying a different electrical outlet.
The remote control is in the right place for once.

guidance.description: Starting the day with satisfaction – that’s what we all want, isn’t it? The great thing is: contentment is not dependent on a bulging bank account. Rather, it depends on your inner attitude and self-care. With the following tips, you can bring more contentment into your everyday life!

comparisons.description: 'Satisfaction' is a gentle 'checkbox' feeling of confirmation that the situation is progressing in the right direction. 'Delight' and 'relief' are the rewards from perceiving that an outcome has reached an important stage.

Confirming an expected pattern may be a spark that causes satisfaction, which is a value judgment on the state of things. But confirming an expectation could also result in pretty much any other experience. e.g. The blood test results could be great or terrible.

variations.name: satisfied with yourself
variations.description: The sense that you lived up to your own expectations for something that matters to someone.
perceptions: I lived up to what I expected of myself.
The results are likely to please some of my social or existential contacts.

commentaries.quote: To be able to look back upon one's past life with satisfaction is to live twice.
Perfectionism rarely begets perfection, or satisfaction - only disappointment.
Happiness does not come from doing easy work but from the afterglow of satisfaction that comes after the achievement of a difficult task that demanded our best.
We always want more. Whether it is better clothes, a bigger house, faster cars, or the latest gadgets, satisfaction in these days of consumerism is difficult to find.

4,3,2,1.description: satisfaction can happen in any of the spheres: physical, social, mental, existential.
